description: Sanitized PDI troubleshooting patterns for polling.

patterns.name: Poll Day Ran Before All Files Were Generated
patterns.summary: Poll Day can run before Passport has finished producing the complete set of files.

values: Files present but timestamps look wrong

match_rules.label: Only a partial file set is present
Only the network batch is present
Poll Day occurred before the latest Passport file

patterns.next_safe_step: Compare Poll Day time with Passport file creation times and determine whether incomplete data has already been imported or submitted.
patterns.why: Timing evidence separates a simple wait-and-repoll situation from an advanced recovery after incomplete data has already been accepted.
guardrails: If incomplete data was already submitted, do not assume a second Poll Day will safely repair it.
Import deletion/clearing is advanced and must not be automated.

patterns.name: Incomplete / Partial Poll Already Submitted
patterns.summary: If partial data has already been submitted, a normal repoll may no longer be sufficient or safe.

values: Poll completed but data is wrong

patterns.next_safe_step: Stop routine repoll attempts and escalate for deliberate reconciliation of what was imported, submitted, and missing.
patterns.why: Historical cases show that once incomplete data is submitted, recovery may require office reconciliation rather than another routine Poll Day.
guardrails: Do not delete imports, clear paperwork, or edit financial data without deliberate verification and authorization.
